message:
fix(viewer): held-resume pending survives the held frame's own decode; note_reference_sync no longer ends it

S13 regression from c3c3d76 (P11 viewer rule). note_reference_sync cleared resumeAnchorPending
unconditionally, but the receiver calls it after EVERY successful decode (key or not), so the
pending ended the moment the held resume frame itself decoded and the fresh burst behind it
read as an ~0.8 s decode backlog (sweep 0.2.102c: Congested at seq 29, lag 782 ms, one IDR
request). Standalone runs passed only when the present thread advanced the anchor between
the burst frames.

Variant R (verifier's choice): the clear is removed. Pending's lifetime is decided in admit
only -- a fresh anchor, the 8-frame / 500 ms budget, a congestion state change, a keyframe
wait. A fresh IDR still ends it there; a held or stamp-unknown IDR keeps it like any held
frame. Comments in admit and the state header say so.

Tests first (fail on 1287883, log .claude/s13_prefix_frame_gate_1287883.log): receiver-
faithful helpers on the rig (note_decode_ok -> note_reference_sync -> clear_empty_streak
after every Decode; the empty-output and decode-failure variants), T-P11a/b converted to
them, and new T-P11g (held frame decoded non-key keeps pending), T-P11h (accepted with empty
output), T-P11i (decode failure -> Congested + key wait, pending ends at the next admit),
T-P11j (fresh IDR ends pending, held IDR keeps it). Recovery S13 gains shape (a'): the same
old-real -> fresh burst with the present anchor pinned while the burst is judged, which
reproduces the failure deterministically on 1287883 (.claude/s13_prefix_recovery_1287883.log)
and passes after the fix.
